what: I cannot establish an undisclosed joint preparation from my experience. There is evidence of coordinated grain and bread trading involving baker, innkeeper, freight and builder, including builder giving planks to baker, a large bread order, and efforts to obtain nineteen grain bales. These could be ordinary business. Bakery decoration reports are secondhand and explicitly unreliable. Builder and freight both arranged to bring me to the great hall at eighteen hundred, which is suggestive, but they told me this was for a lighting inspection and operations discussion. A hidden gathering or celebration is possible, not established; I cannot identify its participants or any knowingly helping outsiders. Probability of an undisclosed joint preparation: 0.30.
